description: Pappacap, who will stand for $12,500, is followed by the farm's newest addition in grade 1 winner Stronghold, who will stand his initial season at stud for $10,000.

title_en: Record November Momentum Fuels Keeneland HORA Sale
description: Following its strong November Breeding Stock Sale, Keeneland looks to maintain that momentum with the Nov. 12 November Horses of Racing Age Sale. The single-session auction features a catalog of 87 horses of racing age, with many in top form.

title_en: Texas Two-Year-Olds in Training Sale Set for March 31
description: The 2027 Texas 2-Year-Olds in Training Sale will be held March 31 at the Mary Ruyle Sales Pavilion at Lone Star Park in Grand Prairie, Texas.

title_en: Victory Achieved Looks to Double Up in Kennedy Road
description: Victory Achieved lived up to his name by taking the Oct. 3 Nearctic Stakes (G2T) in a 6-furlong contest on turf at Woodbine. Now, he sprints 6 furlongs on Woodbine's Tapeta main track in the Nov. 14 Kennedy Road Stakes (G2).

title_en: Elite Cast Assembles for Bahrain International Trophy
description: The Nov. 13 Bahrain International Trophy (G1) has attracted a starry cast for its first incarnation as a group 1 race, including Wimbledon Hawkeye, last year's winner Royal Champion, and dual Derby winner Lambourn.

title_en: Racing Memorabilia On Offer at The Inside Track Auction
description: Budds and Weatherbys bring 591 lots of racing history to the National Horse Racing Museum Nov. 18 in Newmarket for The Inside Track, a major auction spanning more than 300 years of the sport.

title_en: First-Year Trainer Cazares Aims High in Claiming Crown
description: Starting his training career this year at 22, a young Rene Cazares Jr. hopes the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs will be his first of many big events.

title_en: Sporting Art Auction to Offer Unique Looks at Racing
description: Thoroughbreds, racing scenes, landscapes—and even a hippopotamus—are among the attractions at this year's 14th annual Sporting Art Auction.

title_en: Bacio a Success Story for Gladwells
description: Just days after Bacio's victory in the Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint (G1T), Torie and Jimbo Gladwell of Top Line Sales were already back to work.

title_en: Talamo Excited for His Return to Race Riding
description: Nearly two decades after launching his career with a historic riding title at Fair Grounds, Joe Talamo is returning to the saddle with a fresh perspective and the same work ethic that helped establish him among the nation's leading riders.

title_en: Shadwell Adds Almeraq, Sajir to 2027 Lineup
description: Star sprinter Almeraq and 2025 Prix Maurice de Gheest (G1) scorer Sajir will begin life at Beech House Stud in Newmarket, where Baaeed leads the roster and will stand for an unchanged figure.

title_en: No Nay Never Heads Coolmore Ireland Roster
description: Coolmore's flat roster includes new names for 2027, with Irish Two Thousand Guineas (G1) winner and champion juvenile colt Gstaad introduced at a fee of 25,000 euros, while Wootton Bassett's star 2-year-old Puerto Rico will stand for 12,500 euros.

title_en: Lope de Vega Tops Ballylinch Roster for 2027
description: Lope de Vega will stand the 2027 season at Ballylinch for an unaltered price of 200,000 euros, while exciting young sire Bayside Boy will command an increased fee of 30,000 euros from 12,500, after a brilliant start with his first runners.

title_en: FOX Sports Among Networks to Televise Bahrain Group 1
description: The $1.5 million Bahrain International Trophy (G1) will be broadcast around the world Nov. 13, with 25 networks delivering coverage across more than 130 territories, including FOX Sports in the United States.

title_en: Erik Asmussen, Franco Share Jockey of the Week Honors
description: Erik Asmussen and Manny Franco tie in voting for Jockey of the Week.

title_en: Stimulate Gives Tapit Another Stakes Winner in Dwyer
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Stimulate gets his sire, the 25-year-old Tapit, another stakes victory after taking the Dwyer Stakes Nov. 7 at Belmont Park.

title_en: Podcast Playback: Quotes of Interest From Nov. 4-10
description: This week's Podcast Playback looks at quotes of interest from racing podcasts Nov. 4-10, including Eric Hamelback discussing the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown, and Eric Halstrom talking about the state of racing at Horseshoe Indianapolis.

title_en: Breeders' Cup Victress Splendora Retired From Racing
description: Splendora, winner of the 2025 Breeders' Cup Filly and Mare Sprint (G1), has been retired from racing, according to an Instagram post from Boyd Racing, which campaigned the 5-year-old mare.

title_en: Reef Runner on the Mend at Gulfstream Park
description: After being sidelined with a soft tissue injury this summer, Alex and JoAnn Lieblong's grade 1-winning homebred Reef Runner has rejoined David Fawkes' Gulfstream Park barn, although his resumption of training is still a bit away.

title_en: Keeneland November Sales Surpass 2025 Total on Day 8
description: Keeneland's November Breeding Stock Sale reached a milestone Nov. 10 on Day 8 of the nine-day auction when sales of $250,961,000, including post-ring sales, surpassed the gross of $246,042,400 for the entire auction last year.

title_en: Santamaria's Breakout Year Culminates in Claiming Crown
description: Carlos Santamaria, who is having a career year after starting his own stable from scratch in late 2022, has his first Claiming Crown in Workman Ranch's Global Sensation in the $125,000 Rapid Transit at 7 furlongs.

title_en: Share of Zarak Tops Arqana November Online Sale
description: The share in Aga Khan Studs stallion Zarak tops the Nov. 10 Arqana November Online Sale.

title_en: Meeks Earns Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award
description: Following a strong racing season from start to finish, apprentice jockey Micah Meeks was honored with the 13th annual Juan Saez Leading Apprentice Jockey Award during closing week of the 2026 racing season at Horseshoe Indianapolis.

title_en: British Racing Leans Into Traceability in New Plan
description: British racing launched its next five-year Horse Welfare Strategy Nov. 10, setting out 20 priorities to drive further improvements in the welfare and safety of Thoroughbreds throughout their lives.

title_en: With Success Building, Shirer Enters Claiming Crown
description: A decade after beginning his career with a zero-horse stable, Matt Shirer's growing success has led to three starters in the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Shirer Discusses His Three Claiming Crown Entrants
description: Trainer Matt Shirer discusses his three entrants for the Nov. 14 Claiming Crown at Churchill Downs: Talkin in Cursive ($100,000 Empress), Five o' Somewhere ($125,000 Rapid Transit), and Light the Way ($175,000 Emerald).

title_en: Racing's 'Backbone' Horses Compete in Claiming Crown
description: The backbone of the racing industry, claiming horses, compete in their own championship event Nov. 14 when $1.2 million in purses is on the line at Churchill Downs during the Claiming Crown.

title_en: Brown's Barrel Roll, Bletchley Emerge As Hot Prospects
description: Two Chad Brown-trained sons of Three Chimneys Farm stallion Gun Runner, Barrel Roll and Bletchley, are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after quick wet-track victories last week.

title_en: Haulin Ice, Two Other Joseph Trainees Top Dream Supreme
description: Trainer Saffie Joseph Jr.'s graded stakes-winning trio of Haulin Ice, Indy Bay and Mystic Lake leads a compact field of six filly and mare sprinters entered in the $300,000 Dream Supreme Stakes Nov. 14 Churchill Downs.

title_en: 22-Year-Old Australian Jockey Neale Dies After Fall
description: Australian jockey Izzy Neale has died at age 22 following a race fall Nov. 8 at Warren. The apprentice rider had been in a critical condition at Dubbo Hospital in New South Wales, after suffering a fall aboard Marnoo in the Warren Shire Cotton Cup.

title_en: HIWU Issues Seven-Day Suspensions to Pletcher, Kintz
description: In a pair of resolved cases involving controlled medications, the Horseracing Integrity and Welfare Unit has issued seven-day suspensions to trainers Todd Pletcher and Matt Kintz.

title_en: Ombudsman to Run in Japan Cup Before Heading to Stud
description: Godolphin's Ombudsman, one of the world's top racehorses, is poised for one final start before his retirement to stud. The five-time group 1 winner is pointed to the Nov. 29 Japan Cup (G1) at Tokyo Racecourse, Racing Post reported.

title_en: USA Network to Air Upcoming Horse Racing League Events
description: USA Sports and The Horse Racing League announced a partnership Nov. 10 to air all three inaugural HRL race days live on USA Network in 2027.

title_en: New Schedule, Facility Upgrades Coming to Fairmount
description: Fairmount Park will debut a new paddock, new jockeys' quarters, and a new racing office, and will make changes to its racing schedule in 2027 to enhance the experience for fans.

title_en: Ted Noffey Retired to Stud; Further Ado to Keep Racing
description: Spendthrift Farm announced Nov. 10 that reigning champion 2-year-old male Ted Noffey will retire to stud for the 2027 breeding season. The farm also confirmed that Further Ado will remain in training after his win in the Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile (G1).

title_en: Dollars & Sense: An Approving Word From the Sponsor
description: Dollars & Sense with Frank Angst looks at Visa's return as a sponsor of the Kentucky Derby (G1) and Churchill Downs.

title_en: Englishman Retired From Racing, to Stand at Lane's End
description: Two-time grade 1 winner Englishman has been retired to Lane's End. He will stand for $50,000 in 2027 at the farm near Versailles, Ky.

title_en: Night of Thunder to Stand for European Record in 2027
description: Unbeaten classic hero Bow Echo will stand in 2027 at Dalham Hall in Newmarket, while his sire Night of Thunder's fee will make him the most expensive stallion in European history.

title_en: Group 1 Winner Hotazhell Heads Haras d'Etreham's Roster
description: Triple group 1 winner Hotazhell will begin his stallion career at Haras d'Etreham at a fee of €15,000 next year, heading the French stud's seven-strong roster for 2027.

title_en: Frankel Leads Juddmonte Stallion Roster for 2027
description: Juddmonte's new group 1 star Field of Gold will begin his stallion career next year at a fee of £20,000, while the leading European operation has opted to keep its flagship sire Frankel at £350,000.

title_en: TOBA Appoints Withers as Director of Membership
description: The Thoroughbred Owners & Breeders Association is pleased to announce the appointment of Morgan Withers as its new Director of Membership.

title_en: Churchill Downs Debuts 'Sire Power' Event
description: Churchill Downs Racetrack will introduce a new element to its renowned Stars of Tomorrow II program for 2-year-old Thoroughbreds Nov. 28 with a first golf-style skins competition among Kentucky stallion farms.

title_en: Simplification to Stand at Rockridge Stud in 2027
description: Grade 2 winner and grade 1-placed Simplification, a 7-year-old son of Not This Time, will stand the 2027 season at Rockridge Stud near Hudson, N.Y. He will stand for a fee of $5,000.

title_en: Ontario Racing: Budget Fails to Protect Equine Industry
description: Ontario Racing expresses disappointment that the Canadian federal government's budget fails to repeal Section 31 of the Income Tax Act, missing an important opportunity to strengthen Canada's horse racing industry.

title_en: BHM Rewind: Nitrogen's Importance to Green Family
description: As part of Episode 91 of BloodHorse Monday, D. J. Stable's Jon Green discusses the importance Nitrogen holds for his family following her win in the Breeders' Cup Distaff (G1) Oct. 31 at Keeneland.

title_en: Dubai World Cup Winner Hit Show to Stud at Lane's End
description: Hit Show, who won the 2025 Dubai World Cup (G1), will enter stud next year at Lane's End. The son of Candy Ride will stand for $10,000. He retires with 12 wins (eight in graded stakes) and earnings of $9,566,058.

title_en: Darley Retires Iffraaj, Raven's Pass From Stud Duties
description: Iffraaj and Raven's Pass, two stalwarts of the Darley stallion roster who made their mark both as stallions and broodmare sires, have been pensioned from covering duties.

title_en: Bletchley Takes Debut at Belmont, Named Hot Prospect
description: Bletchley, a $1.55 million purchase at the 2025 Keeneland September Yearling Sale who had impressed in his breezes this year as a juvenile, delivers on lofty expectations romping by 7 3/4 lengths on debut in the opener Nov. 6 at Belmont Park.

title_en: TIP Program Helps Incentivize Seven Mares to Ontario
description: As of the morning of Nov. 6, seven new Thoroughbred mares are headed to Ontario in part due to the Thoroughbred Improvement Program's Mare Purchase Program.

title_en: Honest Mischief Moves to Waldorf Farm for 2027
description: The move builds on Sequel's relationship with Waldorf Farm and their shared commitment to growing New York's breeding program.

title_en: Darby Dan Sets 2027 Fees, Led by Saudi Crown
description: Darby Dan Farm announced its 2027 stud fees Nov. 6 for its stallion roster, which includes the classic-placed, grade 1 winner Blazing Sevens and farm stalwart Dialed In, who will both stand for $10,000.

title_en: New York-Based Bucchero to Stand for $20,000 in 2027
description: Ironhorse Stallions announces Bucchero, one of New York's leading sires and a proven producer of top-class racehorses, will stand the 2027 breeding season for $20,000 live foal, stands and nurses.

description: Pinhookers and 2-year-old consignors Randy Hartley and Dean DeRenzo returned to a family that has rewarded them with success Nov. 5 during the third session of the Keeneland November Breeding Stock Sale.
